title: 第三十章 悟到了
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
季南北舒展了一下身体。

    不自觉地，喉间溢出几丝低低的哼声。

    虽是季南北在操控身躯，但听见萧京溪的嗓音这般响起，总觉得......

    实在有点怪怪的!

    【奖励魔道点五万，三品丹药聚灵丹已存入系统空间。】

    待萧京溪讲述完事情经过，系统的奖励提示终于响起，表明此事确已了结。

    步出房门，迎面便瞧见汪天韵与白洁。

    “萧真传安好!”

    “师姐好!”季南北略带疑惑地瞥了汪天韵一眼。

    这小子怎么回事?

    怎么改口了，不像以往那般套近乎了?

    莫非是醒悟了?

    知晓自己高攀不上萧京溪?

    或是拖延太久，兴致已淡，转而心系他人了?

    不论哪般，季南北顿觉这人顺眼了不少。

    “二位好，二位好。”

    季南北含笑向两人致意。

    不料，这两人神色略显微妙，互相对视一眼。

    季南北愈发纳闷。

    嗯?

    你俩莫非......有情况?

    然而，二人只是觉得眼前这位小剑仙着实令人敬畏。

    平日与同门相处，竟能这般温和友善，微笑间如春风拂面。

    一旦遭遇敌手，那份果决几近狠厉，半字不答，拔剑便斩，硬生生杀出一条路。

    昨日那一剑之威，至今仍觉剑气迫在眉睫。

    这般反差，教人如何不神色微妙?

    季南北也未深究这两人究竟怎么回事，反正不关他这位“小剑仙”的事便好。

    “宗门那边，事情处置得如何了?”

    白洁此时敛起那奇异的神情，开口道:“师姐安排周详，昨夜门中便有长老与执事星夜赶来。如今落灵城诸事已大致处置完毕。”

    季南北听罢，点了点头。

    不愧是我!

    “那我等是否此刻召集弟子，启程上路?”

    汪天韵试探着问道。
content_en:
Ji Nanbei stretched his body.

    Unconsciously, a few low hums escaped from his throat.

    Although Ji Nanbei is controlling the body, hearing Xiao Jingxi's voice sound like this makes me feel...

    It’s really a bit weird!

    [The reward is 50,000 magic points, and the third-grade elixir, the Spirit Gathering Pill, has been stored in the system space. 】

    After Xiao Jingxi finished telling what happened, the system's reward prompt finally sounded, indicating that the matter was indeed settled.

    Stepping out of the room, they saw Wang Tianyun and Bai Jie.

    "Xiao Zhenzhuan is well!"

    "Hello, senior sister!" Ji Nanbei glanced at Wang Tianyun with some confusion.

    What's going on with this kid?

    Why did you change your words and not be as close as before?

    Could it be that he has woken up?

    Do you know that you can't reach Xiao Jingxi?

    Or have you procrastinated for too long, your interest has faded, and you have turned your attention to others?

    No matter what, Ji Nanbei suddenly felt that this person was quite pleasing to the eye.

    "Hello, you two. Hello, you two."

    Ji Nanbei greeted the two with a smile.

    Unexpectedly, the two people looked at each other with slightly subtle expressions.

    Ji Nanbei became increasingly puzzled.

    Huh?

    Could it be that you two... have something going on?

    However, the two of them just felt that the little sword fairy in front of them was really awesome.

    When I get along with my classmates on weekdays, I can be so gentle and friendly, and my smile is like the spring breeze blowing on my face.

    Once he encounters an opponent, his decisiveness is almost ruthless. Without answering even a word, he draws his sword and strikes, cutting his way out of the way.

    The power of the sword yesterday still feels imminent.

    With such a contrast, how can one not look subtle?

    Ji Nanbei didn't delve into what was going on with these two people. Anyway, it was nothing to do with him, the "little sword fairy".

    "How are things going on with the sect?"

    Bai Jie suppressed her strange expression at this time and said: "Senior sister has made careful arrangements. Elders and deacons came to the gate last night. Now everything in Luoling City has been roughly dealt with."

    After hearing this, Ji Nanbei nodded.

    As expected of me!

    "Then shall we gather our disciples now and set off on the road?"

    Wang Tianyun asked tentatively.
